name: The Glowing Fruit
label: Quest
description: The Glowing Fruit is a quest in Teldrassil initiated by discovering a strange fruited plant growing wild in the forest. Suspecting something unnatural…
intro: The Glowing Fruit is a quest in Teldrassil initiated by discovering a strange fruited plant growing wild in the forest. Suspecting something unnatural, young adventurers deliver the luminescent specimen to the herbalist Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth for study.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hanging from beneath its fronds of this glowing plant is a large, round fruit.
Denalan would want to study this fruit, you are certain.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, you look like you have something to tell me. Do you have news concerning the timberlings?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found this on Teldrassil? Intriguing... This fruit is exotic. Perhaps its seeds were brought here from far off. Perhaps even as far as Azeroth! And there's something about this fruit... It seems to have reacted very strangely with the soil of Teldrassil.
Thank you, friend. Now if you'll excuse me, I must study this further...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
